heroTitle: Highest Silver Grades in the World
heroDescription: 7.5 million ounces at 8,582 g/t silver, drilling toward 30-100 million ounce potential. Operating the district's only permitted processor. Federal innovation funding advancing Re-2Ox technology for complex concentrates globally stranded by penalty elements.
aboutDescription: Nord combines high-grade silver exploration at Castle East, where drilling targets 30-100 million ounces, with the district's only operating processing facility. Our 20,000 sq ft TTL plant processes high-grade material into silver doré while advancing Re-2Ox technology for complex concentrates. Our approach prioritizes securing mineralized material before scaling capacity, a disciplined strategy in a sector often challenged by processing facilities lacking adequate feed
infoBlock1Note: 7.5M oz resource expanding through 60,000m drilling. Underground access to broken ore plus high-grade tailings.
infoBlock2Note: Operating 24 tonne/day gravity plant. Bullion furnace capacity: 1M+ oz silver annually. Former Ontario government facility.
infoBlock3Note: MICA-funded pilot addressing arsenic-led penalty elements. SGS advancing toward commercial deployment.
infoBlock4Note: Multiple bonanza-grade intersections including 89,853 g/t, 70,380 g/t, and 50,583 g/t silver confirm potential for district-scale discovery at Castle East.
silverTitle: Building Value Through Grade and Infrastructure
silverDescription: At 8,582 g/t silver, Castle East ranks among the world's highest-grade silver deposits. These grades, approximately 27 times the industry average, fundamentally alter project economics—requiring less tonnage and processing for equivalent metal production. The integration with TTL creates a reflexive opportunity where processing revenues fund continued exploration, while exploration success enhances processing opportunities.
temiskamingTitle: TTL: From Government Lab to Production Hub
temiskamingDescription: Acquired in 2020, our Temiskaming Testing Labs served the district for decades, pouring millions of ounces for Agnico and Teck. Now upgraded with 20 tonne/hour crushing, 24 tonne/day gravity circuits, and 6,000 assay/month analytical capacity, TTL processes both our material and third-party feeds while advancing the Re-2Ox pilot.
re2OxDescription: Arsenic is a key penalty element limiting global processing, followed by antimony, bismuth, and others. Our hydrometallurgical process addresses this, with SGS validation showing >99% stabilization. As smelter capacity shrinks, field-deployable Re-2Ox units offer mine-site solutions.
re2OxInfo1Note: Arsenic-led suite including Sb, Bi, Cd, Pb. Containerized units deploy where concentrates are produced.
re2OxInfo2Note: 22.6% battery-grade cobalt sulfate from Castle concentrates. 99% Co recovery, 81% Ni recovery.
